name: Message of the Day
description: The line every player is greeted with at login.

keys.note: mangosd reads this once, at startup; the console reports it with `.server motd`

patches.replace: Motd = "Welcome to the Continued Massive Network Game Object Server."
patches.note: the line mangos-tbc ships in mangosd.conf.dist.in

notes: The one manifest whose effect the running server states back: `.server motd` on the
mangosd console prints `sWorld.GetMotd()` (Chat.cpp -> HandleServerMotdCommand), so a
restart followed by that command is proof the value arrived, with no client involved.
Do not put a double quote in the text: the value is written into a quoted conf field.
